entities.name: Büşra Kılıçlı
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Büşra Kılıçlı is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 188 cm (6.17 ft) and plays as a middle-blocker. She currently plays for Türk Hava Yolları and wears number 12. She is regular Turkish national team player, including at the 2012 Summer Olympics.
